Title: Traffic Manager available only in the Azure portal from April 3

Body.Content:
Starting April 3, 2017, the Azure Traffic Manager service will be available only in the Azure portal. We encourage customers to try Traffic Manager in the Azure portal now and provide us feedback.
 
For more details on how to get started in the Azure portal, please refer to the Traffic Manager documentation.
